description: Implementation of the StatusTracker class managing camera component states, fences, and device status within Android's camera framework.

classes.name: StatusTracker
classes.description: Manages the status of camera components, fences, and overall device state, including thread loop for status updates.

methods.name: addComponent
methods.description: Adds a new camera component with a specified name, assigns an ID, and updates internal state.

methods.name: removeComponent
methods.description: Removes a camera component by ID and updates internal state.

methods.name: dumpActiveComponents
methods.description: Logs all currently active camera components.

methods.name: markComponentIdle
methods.description: Marks a specified component as idle with an associated fence.

methods.name: markComponentActive
methods.description: Marks a specified component as active.

methods.name: markComponent
methods.description: Updates the state of a component to idle or active with an optional fence.

methods.name: getDeviceStateLocked
methods.description: Determines the overall device state based on component statuses and fences.

methods.name: threadLoop
methods.description: Main loop for processing status updates, fences, and notifying parent device of state changes.
